title: Discrete vs. Continuous: A Comprehensive Study of Unified Audio Understanding in LALMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.22851v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) utilize either continuous features or discrete tokens, yet the optimal representation paradigm for general audio understanding remains debated. Existing benchmarks often focus on narrow domains or evaluate encoders outside LALM contexts. To address these gaps, we systematically evaluate continuous and discrete representations across speech, sound and music. Utilizing our UniARC framework with dual evaluation strategies across model scales from SmolLM2-135M to Llama-3-8B, we analyze the dynamic relationships of data volume, model capacity, and computational efficiency. Our results reveal the pivotal role of semantic constraints in tokenization for audio understanding and demonstrate that scaling backbones fail to compensate for information loss in audio representation, especially in data-limited tasks. These findings offer practical guidance for balancing semantic density, fidelity, and efficiency in

translated_title: 离散与连续：大型音频语言模型（LALM）中统一音频理解的全面研究
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）使用连续特征或离散标记，但对于通用音频理解而言，最优的表示范式仍存在争议。现有基准测试往往局限于狭窄的领域，或是在 LALM 语境之外评估编码器。为弥补这些空白，我们系统地评估了语音、声音和音乐领域的连续与离散表示。利用我们提出的 UniARC 框架，采用双重评估策略，在从 SmolLM2-135M 到 Llama-3-8B 的模型规模上进行实验，我们分析了数据量、模型容量和计算效率之间的动态关系。我们的结果揭示了语义约束在音频理解分词化中的关键作用，并证明扩大主干模型规模无法弥补音频表示中的信息损失，尤其是在数据受限的任务中。这些发现为在音频表示中平衡语义密度、保真度和效率提供了实践指导。
tldr: 本研究通过 UniARC 框架系统比较了大型音频语言模型中连续与离散音频表示的性能，揭示了分词中的语义约束对音频理解至关重要，且单纯扩大模型规模无法弥补音频表示中的信息损失。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares continuous vs. discrete audio representations in Large Audio Language Models using the UniARC framework, revealing that semantic constraints in tokenization are pivotal for audio understanding and that scaling backbones cannot compensate for information loss in audio representations.
